CustomField.label: Promotion Applied
CustomField.description: A promotion (coupon) discounts this line: it has a Promotion price adjustment linked to a promotion. Set by RepriceQuotesPST when the quote's Coupon Code is applied or removed. Promotional lines are exempt from the floor price check (PRC-18, decision 13 Nov).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked when a promotion discounts this line. Promotional lines don't need floor price approval.
